annotations.title: Add-on candidates for a platform company

description: Computed addon_for_platform matches for one platform (a dfx:pe: company id from search_pe_platforms): each candidate company with the matcher's reasons, blockers, why_now and comparable add-ons verbatim, the platform's owner, score, confidence and computed date. NOT_COVERED when the matcher has scored nothing for the platform, which is not a statement that no add-on fits.

dfx_id.description: A private equity graph id of the form dfx:pe:<uuid>, as returned by search_pe_firms, search_pe_funds, search_pe_platforms or search_entities.

name: find_pe_addons_for_platform
